answer_1.quote: "Question Generation (QG) aims to generate questions from a given answer and a grounding paragraph..."

answer_2.quote: "We adopt several metrics to evaluate diversity and consistency: 1) Top-1 BLEU ... 2) Oracle BLEU ... 3) Pairwise BLEU ... 4) Overall BLEU ... Additionally we report Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores from a QA model."

answer_4.quote: "We followed to evaluate the consistency and diversity of RAST and Nucleus sample on 50 samples of SQuAD /1. ... each sample has been checked by three annotators... Fleiss' Kappa 0.61 ..."
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated question for consistency (answerability, hallucination) on a 0‑5 scale and counted distinct questions for diversity.
